newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.1 pct -- BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.1 pct -- BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.1 percent in the week ended June 28 from the previous week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.1 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index slipped 0.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on-to-above plan for the week, with sales cited as stronger earlier in the week but softer toward the end of the week," the report said.
